jobs.description:
Our client is a large Belgian organization with an extensive and business-critical IT environment. What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
 

 
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
 
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
 
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
 
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
 
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment 

 
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
 
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• A forklift certificate is a plus
 
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)

Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed nightshift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.

We are looking for a Logistics Administrator to manage the entire administrative process for shipping and receiving goods. You will ensure timely deliveries while monitoring compliance with customs regulations.Your responsibilities:Administrative support for goods movement:

• Prepare shipping and receiving documents (such as Air Waybills and pro forma invoices).
• Create and follow up on purchase requisitions and orders in the ERP system.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date data in IT systems.
Transport coordination:

• Schedule and monitor all transport bookings, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Customs compliance:

• Verify and ensure adherence to applicable customs laws and regulations.
• Review documents for inbound and outbound shipments.
Reporting:

• Prepare and submit periodic reports on imports and exports.
Your Impact:

• Serve as the first point of contact for daily transport-related queries.
• Ensure timely and complete administrative handling of shipments and related reporting.
• Maintain proper documentation for customs and compliance purposes.

Your profile:

• A higher education degree.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role.
• Solid proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems.
• Practical knowledge of ADR regulations, customs laws, and Incoterms (or willingness to follow training).
• Understanding of logistics operations, including both road and air freight.
• A structured and precise approach, consistently following established procedures.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset, able to anticipate and prevent issues.
• Flexibility to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Able to work independently after a six-month training period.
• You have excellent knowledge of English and a good understanding of Dutch or French, sufficient for both internal communication and contacts with external suppliers.
